name: mac-ocr
description: macOS CLI for OCR and searchable PDFs using Apple's Vision framework. Recognize text in images and PDFs, stream PDF pages, and add an invisible selectable text layer over scanned pages.

scripts.build: node scripts/write-version.mjs && swift build -c release --arch arm64 --arch x86_64 -Xswiftc -Osize -Xlinker -dead_strip && mkdir -p bin && cp .build/apple/Products/Release/mac-ocr bin/mac-ocr && strip -rSTx bin/mac-ocr && pkgroll
scripts.lint: lintroll --git . && swift format lint --strict --recursive --parallel Sources Tests
scripts.test:node: swift build && mkdir -p bin && cp .build/debug/mac-ocr bin/mac-ocr && node Tests/index.ts
